I replied to Dana in a thread on her message in #north-random: the ticket for the Zoom Room B hub replacement is **IT ticket #4092**.

The only source is a message Ilse Varga posted in that same channel yesterday (Oct 13, 11:55), saying IT has #4092 open to replace the hub. I passed on her warning too: don't unplug the main power brick under the table, or the Polycom resets. #help-it-ops had no messages, so I couldn't check the ticket's current status.
